config.name: Active Alerts — Read First
config.description: Read first guide for this dashboard.
config.content:
Active Alerts
Operational cockpit for severity, trends, rules, integrations, and LogicModule noise.
Questions this dashboard answers
  • What is alerting by severity?
  • Are rules and escalations healthy?
  • Which datasources generate the most noise?
  • Are integrations failing?
Recommended review flow
  1. Severity KPIs — Critical / Error / Warning / Total
  2. Alert list — Live exceptions
  3. Trends + top datasources — Noise
  4. Rules / escalations / integrations — Routing health
  5. 90-day module tables — Content noise
Where to go next
  • Collector-caused gaps → 31
  • Noisy modules deep dive → 32
  • Spatial concentration → 22
  • Technical investigation → 30
Tip: Empty or zero values may mean healthy state or missing tokens/LogicModules — confirm before concluding.
